featured_reviews.review_text: I’m a Catholic visitor from Australia. Beautiful church,  loads of reverence during service. So glad to have had this experience. Furthermore, modesty and respectful attire impressed me more than I can say. I will attend more daily masses until I leave on Wednesday. If the parish priest is open to suggestions I have just one! featured_reviews.name: Joseph D'Cruz
featured_reviews.review_text: This is one of the oldest places in Vakola. This Catholic parish was very large (in terms of members) in the 80's and 90's with almost 30000 families being part of it but due to cost of living going up and real-estate prices going through the roof many have sold their places and moved to the suburbs. Currently the numbers have come down to almost close to 10000 or little above that. Still one of the very active churches in terms of people's participation. There are 5 resident priests allotted to this parish. There's also boys school run by the parish. A very spiritual place and the services are conducted with a lot of vigour and enthusiasm. Truly fulfilling to be part of those.

featured_reviews.name: Sean Kennedy
featured_reviews.review_text:
St Vincent De Paul Church is more than a place of worship—it is a layered story of faith, time, and community, expressed through five defining pillars:

Miracles
Stories of quiet grace echo through generations—answered prayers, moments of healing, and an unspoken belief that faith here finds its way. The church carries an aura where the intangible feels deeply personal.

Heritage
Rooted in the legacy of Chuim village, its origins date back to the 1940s, evolving alongside Mumbai’s transformation while preserving its old-world soul and spiritual continuity.

Architecture
A harmonious blend of simplicity and purpose, its structure balances modern functionality with sacred calm—featuring serene interiors, soft natural light, and spaces designed for reflection.

Parishioners
The heartbeat of the church—diverse yet deeply connected. Generations of families shape its identity, carrying forward traditions with warmth, service, and collective faith.

Activities
Beyond prayer, it thrives as a hub of engagement—community outreach, youth initiatives, charitable work, and celebrations that bind people together in purpose and spirit.

featured_reviews.name: Divya Alisha Mathews
featured_reviews.review_text: This is a non-denominational church. A few years ago I was looking out for a church. I wanted the Holy Spirit to tell me which church I should be in. So one Sunday, I walked into ARH and I immediately felt the tangible  presence of God. Holy Spirit confirmed it to me in my spirit that I should remain here. It has taught me to linger in God's presence and to grow spiritually day by day.  It teaches about the love Jesus demonstrated on the cross. And this non-judgmental love is reflected as you walk through the doors of ARH. In fact, anyone who knows God and His Word well will recognize the genuine love and worship overflowing in this place. The pastors here are anointed people of God. They are very humble and they teach the Word of God with such simplicity that anyone can understand. This church never hides their passion for God. Love love love being a part of ARH.

featured_reviews.name: Advait Praturi
featured_reviews.review_text: I first joined this community almost 4 years ago. It's been a great journey. It's attractive for its vision. This is a movement-minded community that wants to bring hope and change to the city we live in. It's great to be able to be part of something bigger than myself. And I've made more some very close and good friends along the way.

featured_reviews.name: Dennis K
featured_reviews.review_text:
I moved to Bombay from a small town 5 years ago and got connected to Avatar. My first impression of this community was; "If Bombay had a face, these guys should be it." I couldn't help but notice how such a bunch of talented young professionals, entrepreneurs, entertainment industry professionals, musicians, social workers, parents, and drifters somehow all managed to gather under one roof. Honestly, I would never expect busy Bombay folk to have the time to show up on a Sunday morning for something as tedious as church. And still, i could see how people were being drawn to this place every Sunday.
This community has challenged so many of my self-seeking world views and has continuously provided some great perspective on God's heart for me. I have forged many great friendships here that i will carry with me for the rest of my life.
I am really thankful for the effort made here to reveal the good news of Christ in a relevant way without watering down anything, but rather pushing for the truth to move forward in our lives.
One of the memories i really love about Avatar is from the time we used to hold our Sunday meetings in someone's living room and how the place smelled of freshly brewed coffee as you entered in. And then you got to drink it..
I highly recommend this place. I have personally found this is to be a great place to meet God, experience God's love and learn how to impact your world.

featured_reviews.name: Melissa Henderson
featured_reviews.review_text: I was a part of the Avatar community for 6 years. My biggest concern when moving to Mumbai from the US was about whether I would find a good church in such a huge city. I had heard about Avatar even before I got to India, and during my first week in Mumbai, one of my colleagues brought me to Avatar. As soon as the service started I felt home <3. I have not even tried any other churches till date! Avatar is a good mix of locals and expats, and they really love people well. I felt so welcome there, and they invite all with open arms! This community really became my family in Mumbai. I couldn't have stayed in Mumbai for 6 years if it wasn't for NLF, and I will never forget my time with this COMMUNITY. That is really what Avatar is. Yes, the services are great - the worship and word - and I definitely grew closer to God while I attended Avatar. But events, programs, and the building aside, they really embody Philippians 1:3-11 for me. Love you guys!

featured_reviews.name: Karan Thomas
featured_reviews.review_text: Had a wonderful Sunday service at Avatar. They come across as a real and transparent people group who inspire each other in the lifestyle of Christ. They had facilities for toddlers, and good coffee. Makes the 2 hour service experience quite comfortable.

featured_reviews.name: bennet david
featured_reviews.review_text: Its been 2 years since we have been part of the Avatar family. It's been an absolute joy to share the highs and lows with this extended family. Pastor Mark and the church leadership have an amazing grip on the pulse of this generation and teach and practice life applications that involves a lot of GRACE. Love this community.

featured_reviews.name: Jimit Mehta
featured_reviews.review_text: I have attended Avatar since 2011 and its been an awesome experience. Its a non denominational church - so everyone is welcome! They are a bunch of young people who are passionate about Jesus and passionate about Mumbai. Their services are really warm and welcoming even if you have never been to church before.
